fields.description: Program Description 1. Program Introduction Editor Notes: The syllabus of MBBS program is set according to the MOE regulation and IIME requirements. The main courses in preclinical medicine stage include Biochemistry, Anthroponomy, Embryology, Physiology, Pathogen Biology, Pathology, Pharmacology, pathophysiology and Diagnostics etc. Students need to take Chinese Language and Chinese Culture courses to pass HSK (the Chinese Proficiency Test) grade 4 which is a requirement for the internship in China. The graduates of MBBS program are eligible to take the Medical Licensing Examinations held by the medical councils in different countries such as MCI, PMDC, USMLE, HPCSA, SCHS etc. ​​ 2. Program Structure Editor Notes: The program takes six years to complete. Main Courses: Year Courses 1 st Semester 2 nd Semester 1 st Academic Year (Pre-Med) Basic Mathematics for Medicine I, Introduction to Modern Biological Science,General Physics, Basic Mathematics for Medicine Ⅱ, Chinese Ⅰ General Physics Lab, Cell Biology, Organic Chemistry,Chinese Ⅱ,History of Medicine,Global Health,Early Exposure To Clinic 2 nd Academic Year (Pre-Clinic) Biochemistry,Histology & Embryology,Systematic Anatomy,Chinese Ⅲ Biochemistry Lab,Medical Genetics,Physiology,Regional Anatomy,Medical Psychology,Chinese Ⅳ 3 rd Academic Year (Pre-Clinic) Medical Immunology,Pathology,Medical ,Microbiology &Parasitology,Survey of China,Medical Chinese Pathophysiology,Pharmacology,Forensic medicine ,Internal Medicine Ⅰ,Medical Chinese Ⅰ,Biostatistics 4 th Academic Year (Pre-Clinic and Clinic) Biomedical Informatics,Basic Traditional Chinese Medicine,Surgery I,Preventive Medicine,Social Medicine & Ethics, Epidemiology,Medical Chinese Ⅱ,Basic Medical Sciences Exam Surgery Ⅱ,Radiology,Obstetrics & Gynecology,Internal Medicine Ⅱ,Medical Chinese Ⅲ 5 th Academic Year (Clinic) Pediatrics,Internal Medicine Ⅲ,Surgery Ⅲ,Communicable Diseases,Community Medicine,Medical Chinese Ⅳ Dermatovenereology,Psychiatry,Neurology,Clinical Training,Otorhinolaryngology,Stomatology,Ophthalmology ,Emergency Medicine, Medical Chinese Ⅴ 6 th Academic Year (Clinic) Senior clerkship Senior clerkship *The students must score 190 in HSK(Hanyu Shuiping Kaoshi, the Chinese Proficiency Test) Level Ⅳ or above and pass HSKK(HSK Speaking Test) Intermediate Level before taking the senior clerkship in China. *More than top 20% students can get outstanding academic performance scholarship every year. 3. Hostels and food Editor Notes: Students are expected to live in the International Students Dormitory, where twin rooms are available. Almost every room is equipped with telephone, internet access, private bathroom with shower and air-conditioners. Public kitchens and washing machines are also accessible to students in the dormitory. The University has on all its campuses several convenient and inexpensive restaurants where a good variety of Chinese and Western foods are served. 4. Degree Awarded Editor Notes: International medical undergraduates will be granted a graduation certificate and conferred a medical degree by the ZHU. MBBS Degree: The English copy of the degree will state MBBS (Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery). After obtaining MBBS Degree, the graduates can apply to take the medical licensing examination in the medical council in order to get registered and practice medicine. According to the regulations in different countries, the students may need to do the degree accreditation first. A MBBS degree holder can find jobs in government as well as private hospitals, nursing homes and other health facilities. Except this, one can also start his own clinic or pursue study for master’s degree. 5. Internship Editor Notes: The internship is arranged in the final year and students can do the internship/training in China or their home country. Students who want to do internship in China need to pass the HSK 4 to contact with the patients and the tuition fee for this year is as normal RMB 42,800 per year. The internship will be carried out in the 6 Grade III Class A affiliated hospitals of Zhejiang University. These hospitals have a total capacity of over 7700 beds, 8780,000 emergency visits and 238,000 inpatients. There are no requirements for students who want to do the internship in their home countries on HSK level and no need to pay for the tuition fee. Students have to take the final examination on Theory Test and Clinical Evaluation in ZJU before graduation. 6. School Introduction Editor Notes: Zhejiang University is a Public, 985 Project Comprehensive university. Zhejiang University is a national comprehensive university. Founded in 1897, it was initially known as “Qiushi Shuyuan” (Qiushi Academy), one of the earliest modern academies of higher learning established in China. Zhejiang University‘s fields of study cover philosophy, literature, history, education, science, economics, law, management, engineering, agriculture, medicine and etc. The university, now has 113 specialties for undergraduate studies, and it is entitled to confer master's degrees in 324 programs and primary (secondary) discipline doctoral degrees in 41 (252) programs, Learn More>> 7. School of Medicine Editor Notes: Dating from the 1912, the School now includes 8 faculties, 6 Grade III Class A hospitals affiliated hospitals with 7,700 beds and 23 Grade III teaching hospitals. ZUSM has established international links with scores of medical institutions in Asia, Europe, Australia and North America. Programs like collaborative research projects and exchanges of faculty and students have been launched. The total number of staff has reached over 10,000, including 568 full professors and associate professors, 212 doctoral mentors and 663 master mentors. The School has 4 national key disciplines, one state key laboratory and 15 provincial and ministerial key laboratories. The discipline of Clinical Medicine ranks the 7th in China with the Internal Medicine, Surgery, Pediatric and Oncology as key national disciplines. There are over 4,000 medical students including over 400 international students in MBBS program. 8. Campus Life Editor Notes: International students enjoy the wonderful life in the campus. fields.materials: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. * 1. Personal statement In Chinese or English, should include study experience, reasons for application, personal strengths. No less than 800 words. * 2. Commitments for Zhejiang University Undergraduate Application The PDF version of the Commitments must be clearly and completely filled out and hand-signed. Applications without the Commitments will not be accepted. You can download a template or sample from here . * 3. Two recommendation letters from high school teachers Teachers’ signature, contact phone number and email address must put on the letter. * 4. A photocopy of passportfront page. The expiry date of the passport should be after March 1, 2027. * 5. Passport photo White background, 35mm×45mm in size. * 6. Photocopies of language proficiency certificates. Applicants for English-instructed programs must provide the certificate of TOEFL or IELTS test score. (Not required for English native speakers) * 7. Transcript for all the courses in senior high school (original copy or notarized copy) Transcript for all the courses in senior high school (original copy or notarized copy in Chinese/English); * 8. Senior high school diploma (original copy or notarized copy) Senior high school diploma (original copy or notarized copy in Chinese/English); Graduating high school students can provide pre-graduation Certificate instead (in Chinese/English). 9. Award-winning Certificates related to academic courses during your senior high school period. (If any) * 10. CSCA Test Transcript(s) -You need to take the official CSCA test organized by the Chinese government and submit the corresponding subject result transcript(s) when applying. Learn more about the CSCA test >> -The test covers Chinese (Humanities and STEM Chinese), Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry. Mathematics is required for all programs, while other subjects depend on the university’s specific requirements. -We are updating detailed information for each university, including the required subjects you have to take for each program and their score requirements. Once the updates are ready, you can check the attachment and information here for this university for the latest information. If no attachment is available yet, it usually means the university has not announced further details. You can download a template or sample from here . Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.
fields.requirements: Entry Requirements 1.Requirements on Citizenship 1.1 Non-Chinese citizens with an ordinary private passport. 1.2 Requirements of the regulations set in the Document No. 12 (2020) of Ministry of Education of the PRC should be met (Link). 1.2.1 Applicants who have given up their original Chinese citizenship (including residents in Hong Kong, Macao, and Taiwan) and become foreign citizens, must acquire foreign citizenship before April 30, 2023, and must have lived abroad for more than 2 years from April 30, 2023 to April 30, 2027 (more than 9 months of residence abroad per year can be considered as one year, taking entry and exit stamps as evidence). 1.2.2 If the applicant has acquired foreign citizenship automatically at the time of birth in a foreign country, whose parents were both Chinese citizens, or one of the parents was a Chinese citizen, the Chinese-citizen parent must have obtained permanent residence in a foreign country before the applicant's birth. Applicants must have lived abroad for more than 2 years from April 30, 2023 to April 30, 2027 (more than 9 months of residence abroad per year can be considered as one year, taking entry and exit stamps as evidence). 2. General Requirements 2.1 In principle, between 18 and 25 years of age. Applicants must graduate from high school (Those who provide pre-graduation certificate or student status certificate at application MUST provide senior high school diploma no later than registration). 2.2 With proper moral conduct, in good health with no infectious disease or any physical or mental diseases that may affect study. Applicants must demonstrate academic excellence, be friendly toward China, and have no record of violations of law or criminal offenses. 2.3 Applicants must provide qualifying Language Proficiency Certificate, a China Scholastic Competency Assessment (CSCA) score report: Mathematics, Chemistry. 3. Language Proficiency Requirements: IELTS: 6.0 overall or above (academic module) with a minimum of 5.0 in each component. TOEFL-iBT: 75 or above with a minimum of 15 in Reading, Listening, Speaking and Writing. Cambridge Certificate in Advanced English (CAE): 170 or above Duolingo: 100 or above. Submission of IB, A-level or other international standardized test score reports, or a full high-school English-medium instruction certificate for applicants with full English-taught high school education, can exempt the applicant from providing an English proficiency certificate. Other requirements:: Applicants must have scored 70% or above in Math, Physics, Chemistry, and Biology (Zoology & Botany) during high school. 4. Offered at the International Schoolof Medicine(located in Yiwu City).
